TKBERTLVRecord.doc: An object that parses BER-encoded data and produces DER-encoded data for TLV records.

TKCompactTLVRecord.doc: An object that implements encoding using Compact-TLV encoding according to ISO 7816-4.

TKSimpleTLVRecord.doc: An object that implements encoding using Simple-TLV encoding according to ISO 7816-4.

TKSmartCard.doc: A representation of a smart card.

TKSmartCardATR.doc: A parsed ATR (Answer To Reset) message from a Smart Card.

TKSmartCardATRInterfaceGroup.doc: A single interface-bytes group for a Smart Card ATR (Answer to Reset).

TKSmartCardPINFormat.doc: The formatting properties for a PIN, such as character encoding and length constraints.

TKSmartCardSlot.doc: A single smart card reader slot in the system.

TKSmartCardSlotManager.doc: An interface to all available smart card reader slots.

TKSmartCardSlotNFCSession.doc: NFC session that’s related to NFC smart card slot which was created.

TKSmartCardToken.doc: A representation of a smart card based cryptographic token.

TKSmartCardTokenDriver.doc: The driver that acts as an entry point for smart card app extensions.

TKSmartCardTokenRegistrationManager.doc: Provides a centralized management system for registering and unregistering smartcards using their token IDs.

TKSmartCardTokenSession.doc: A token session that is based on a smart card token.

TKSmartCardUserInteraction.doc: The base class for encapsulating user interaction with a Smart Card reader.

TKSmartCardUserInteractionForPINOperatio.doc: A representation of user interaction for secure PIN operations on a Smart Card reader.

TKSmartCardUserInteractionForSecurePINCh.doc: A representation of the user interaction for secure PIN change operations on a Smart Card reader.

TKSmartCardUserInteractionForSecurePINVe.doc: A representation of the user interaction for secure PIN change verification on a Smart Card reader.

TKTLVRecord.doc: The base class encapsulating a Tag-Length-Value record.

TKToken.doc: A representation of a hardware-based cryptographic token.

TKTokenAuthOperation.doc: An authentication operation for a cryptographic token.

TKTokenDriver.doc: A base class for building token drivers.

TKTokenDriverConfiguration.doc: A configuration for one class of token.

TKTokenKeyAlgorithm.doc: Cryptographic algorithms used by token keys.

TKTokenKeyExchangeParameters.doc: Parameters used to perform specific key exchange operations.

TKTokenKeychainCertificate.doc: A token’s certificate as stored in the keychain.

TKTokenKeychainContents.doc: A representation of the state of the keychain for a particular token.

TKTokenKeychainItem.doc: An abstract base class for managing a token’s contents as keychain items.

TKTokenKeychainKey.doc: A token’s key as stored in the keychain.

TKTokenSession.doc: A token session that manages the authentication state of a token.

TKTokenSmartCardPINAuthOperation.doc: A Smart Card PIN authentication operation.

TKTokenWatcher.doc: An object that tracks the tokens available in the system.

TKSmartCardTokenDriverDelegate.doc: The interface that a smart card token driver delegate implements to respond to token creation events.

TKSmartCardUserInteractionDelegate.doc: The interface implemented by a Smart Card user interaction delegate to handle user interaction events.

TKTokenDelegate.doc: The interface that a token delegate implements to respond to session creation events.

TKTokenDriverDelegate.doc: The interface that a token driver delegate implements to respond to token creation events.

TKTokenSessionDelegate.doc: The interface that a session instance delegate implements to respond to token session authentication events.

TKTokenOperation.doc: Operations that can be performed with a token’s keys and certificates.

+dataForTag:.doc: Encodes a specified tag using BER-TLV tag encoding rules.

-initWithTag:records:.doc: Initializes a BER-TLV record with the specified tag and an array of TLV subrecords.

-initWithTag:value:.doc: Initializes a BER-TLV record with the specified tag and value.
Initializes a TLV record with the specified tag and value.
Initializes a TLV record with the specified tag and value.

-beginSessionWithReply:.doc: Begins a session with the Smart Card.

-endSession.doc: Completes any pending transmissions and ends the session to the Smart Card.

-inSessionWithError:executeBlock:.doc: Synchronously begins a session, executes the given block, and ends the session.

-sendIns:p1:p2:data:le:reply:.doc: Asynchronously transmits an APDU command to the card, returning the response in a completion handler.

-sendIns:p1:p2:data:le:sw:error:.doc: Synchronously transmits an APDU command to the card and returns the response.

-transmitRequest:reply:.doc: Transmits data in Application Protocol Data Unit (APDU) format to the Smart Card.

-userInteractionForSecurePINChangeWithPI.doc: Creates a new user interaction object for secure PIN change using the smart card reader facilities (typically a HW keypad).

-userInteractionForSecurePINVerification.doc: Creates and returns a new user interaction object for secure PIN verification using the Smart Card reader facilities.

-initWithBytes:.doc: Initializes a TKSmartCardATR object from a provided data object.

-initWithSource:.doc: Initializes a TKSmartCardATR object from a provided data source.

-interfaceGroupAtIndex:.doc: Returns the interface group at the specified index.

-interfaceGroupForProtocol:.doc: Returns the interface group with the specified protocol.

-makeSmartCard.doc: Creates a new TKSmartCard object representing the currently inserted Smart Card.

-createNFCSlotWithMessage:completion:.doc: Creates an NFC smart card slot using the device’s hardware and presents a system UI.

-getSlotWithName:reply:.doc: Asynchronously calls a block with a Smart Card reader slot for a specified name.

-isNFCSupported.doc: Determines whether NFC (Near Field Communication) is supported on this device.

-slotNamed:.doc: Returns the Smart Card slot with a given name.

-endSession.doc: Ends the NFC slot session and dismisses the system-presented NFC UI (if present).

-updateWithMessage:error:.doc: Updates the message of the system-presented NFC UI.

-initWithSmartCard:AID:instanceID:tokenD.doc: Initializes a smart card token with the specified smart card, application identifier, and token driver.

-registerSmartCardWithTokenID:promptMess.doc: Registers a smartcard with a specific token ID.

-unregisterSmartCardWithTokenID:error:.doc: Unregisters a smartcard for the provided token ID.

-cancel.doc: Attempts to cancel an interaction started by calling runWithReply:. For certain interactions, cancellation may not be available.

-runWithReply:.doc: Runs the user interaction and asynchronously receives a reply.

+recordFromData:.doc: Creates and returns a TLV record from by parsing the specified data.

+sequenceOfRecordsFromData:.doc: Creates and returns an array of TLV records from the specified data.

-initWithTokenDriver:instanceID:.doc: Initializes a token with the driver you specify.

-isAlgorithm:.doc: Returns whether the specified algorithm is the target operation algorithm.

-supportsAlgorithm:.doc: Whether the specified algorithm is the target operation algorithm, or one of the other algorithms used.

-initWithCertificate:objectID:.doc: Initializes a token keychain certificate with data from the specified certificate reference and a given object ID.

-certificateForObjectID:error:.doc: Returns the key for a specified object identifier.

-fillWithItems:.doc: Fills the keychain with the specified items.

-keyForObjectID:error:.doc: Returns the key for a specified object identifier.

-initWithObjectID:.doc: Initializes a token keychain item with the specified object ID.

-initWithCertificate:objectID:.doc: Initializes a token keychain key with data from the specified certificate reference and a given object ID.

-initWithToken:.doc: Initializes a token session with the specified token.

-addRemovalHandler:forTokenID:.doc: Adds a removal handler for the specified token ID.

-initWithInsertionHandler:.doc: Initializes a token watcher with the specified insertion handler.

-setInsertionHandler:.doc: Sets an insertion handler closure to be called when a new token is inserted into the system.

allowedProtocols.doc: The protocols allowed for communication with the Smart Card. TKSmartCardProtocolAny by default.

cla.doc: The CLA byte used for APDU transmission. 0x00 by default.

context.doc: User-specified information. This property is automatically set to nil if the Smart Card is removed or another TKSmartCard object begins a session.

currentProtocol.doc: The protocol used for communication with the Smart Card. Returns TKSmartCardProtocolNone if no session is currently established.

send(ins:p1:p2:data:le:).doc: Asynchronously sends an APDU command to the smart card.

send(ins:p1:p2:data:le:reply:).doc: Asynchronously transmits an APDU command to the card, returning the response in a completion handler.

sensitive.doc: Whether sessions established for the Smart Card should be considered sensitive. false by default.

slot.doc: The slot in which the Smart Card is inserted.

useCommandChaining.doc: Whether to use command chaining of APDU with a data field longer than 255 bytes.

useExtendedLength.doc: Whether to use extended length APDU.

valid.doc: Whether the Smart Card is valid and accessible from its slot.

withSession(_:).doc: Synchronously begins a session, executes the given closure, and ends the session.

TKSmartCardATRInterfaceGroup.doc: A single interface-bytes group for a Smart Card ATR (Answer to Reset).

historicalBytes.doc: The ATR historical bytes, not including interface bytes or the TCK (check byte).

historicalRecords.doc: A list of compact TLV records parsed from historical bytes.

protocols.doc: An array of protocols indicated in the ATR

PINBitOffset.doc: The offset, in bits, within the PIN block to mark a location for filling in the formatted PIN, which is justified with respect to the PINJustification property value. 0 by default.

PINBlockByteLength.doc: The total length of the PIN block in bytes. 8 by default.

PINJustification.doc: The justification within the PIN block. TKSmartCardPINJustificationLeft by default.

PINLengthBitOffset.doc: The offset, in bits, within the PIN block to mark a location for filling in the PIN length, which is always left justified. 0 by default.

PINLengthBitSize.doc: The size, in bits, of the PIN length field. If set to 0, PIN length is not written. 0 by default.

charset.doc: The format of PIN characters. TKSmartCardPINCharsetNumeric by default.

encoding.doc: The encoding of PIN characters. TKSmartCardPINEncodingASCII by default.

maxPINLength.doc: The maximum number of characters to form a valid PIN. 8 by default.

minPINLength.doc: The minimum number of characters to form a valid PIN. 4 by default.

ATR.doc: The ATR (Answer to Reset) of the inserted Smart Card, or nil if no Smart Card is inserted or the inserted Smart Card is mute.

maxInputLength.doc: The maximum length of input APDU (Application Protocol Data Unit) that the Smart Card reader slot is able to transfer to the Smart Card.

maxOutputLength.doc: The maximum length of output APDU (Application Protocol Data Unit) that the Smart Card reader slot is able to transfer from the Smart Card.

name.doc: The name of the Smart Card reader slot.

state.doc: The current state of the Smart Card reader slot.

defaultManager.doc: The shared singleton Smart Card reader slot manager.

slotNames.doc: A list of identifiers for all the Smart Card reader slots available to the system.

slotName.doc: Smart card slot name of the NFC slot that was created together with this session.

AID.doc: The ISO 7816-4 application identifiers of the Smart Card.

registeredSmartCardTokens.doc: Returns the tokenIDs of all currently registered smart card tokens

smartCard.doc: The smart card for the active exclusive session and selected application.

delegate.doc: The delegate for observing events that occur during the user interaction.

initialTimeout.doc: The timeout, in seconds, for initial interaction. If set to 0, the reader-defined default timeout is used. 0 by default.

interactionTimeout.doc: The timeout, in seconds, after the first key stroke. If set to 0, the reader-defined default timeout is used. 0 by default.

PINCompletion.doc: The conditions under which PIN entry should be considered complete.

PINMessageIndices.doc: A list of message indices referring to a predefined message table, used to specify the type and number of messages displayed during the PIN operation. nil by default.

locale.doc: The locale for the displayed messages. If nil, the user’s current locale is used. By default, this value is the current locale of the system.

resultData.doc: The returned data without SW1-SW2 bytes, if any.

PINConfirmation.doc: The way PIN confirmation is requested. TKSmartCardPINConfirmationNone by default.

data.doc: The record data, including the tag, length, and value fields.

tag.doc: The tag field of the record.

value.doc: The value field of the record.

TKTokenInstanceID.doc: A type that represents the instance identifier of a token.

TKTokenObjectID.doc: A unique and persistent identifier of a particular token object.

configuration.doc: The current configuration for a token.

keychainContents.doc: The contents of the keychain for this token.

TKTokenDriverClassID.doc: The type of the class identifier for the token driver.

TKTokenDriverConfiguration.doc: A configuration for one class of token.

requestedSize.doc: Returns the requested output size, in bytes, of key exchange result.

sharedInfo.doc: Returns shared information typically used during the key derivation (KDF) step of a key exchange algorithm.

data.doc: Returns a DER-encoded representation of an X.509 certificate.

items.doc: Returns all items for token in the keychain.

constraints.doc: Access constraints for the keychain item, keyed by TKTokenOperation values wrapped in NSNumber objects.

label.doc: The user-visible label for the keychain item.

objectID.doc: Returns the object ID used for keychain item identification.

canDecrypt.doc: Whether the key can be used to decrypt data.

canPerformKeyExchange.doc: Whether the key can be used to perform Diffie-Hellman style cryptographic key exchange.

canSign.doc: Whether the key can be used to sign data.

keyType.doc: The type of the key. Currently, only kSecAttrKeyTypeRSA and kSecAttrKeyTypeECSECPrimeRandom are supported values.

publicKeyHash.doc: The SHA1 hash of the raw public key.

suitableForLogin.doc: Whether the key can be used for system login.

password.doc: The password to be filled in when the finishWithError: is called.

token.doc: The token to which the session is bound.

APDUTemplate.doc: The template into which the PIN is filled in. nil by default.

PIN.doc: The PIN value resulting from performing the operation.

PINByteOffset.doc: The offset, in bytes, within the APDU template to mark the location for filling in the PIN.

smartCard.doc: A Smart Card to which the formatted APDU is sent in order to authenticate.

tokenIDs.doc: The token IDs currently available in the system.
